calls.body: SELECT TraceId, SpanId, SpanName, ServiceName, StatusCode, Duration, SpanAttributes, toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp) AS ts_ns FROM `default`.`otel_traces` WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(1791746400000000000) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(1791750060000000000) AND ServiceName = 'hermes-agent' AND ParentSpanId = '' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, SpanName, SpanKind, ServiceName, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Duration, SpanAttributes, ResourceAttributes, toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp) AS ts_ns, arrayMap(t -> toUnixTimestamp64Nano(t), Events.Timestamp) AS event_ts, Events.Name AS event_names, Events.Attributes AS event_attrs FROM `default`.`otel_traces` WHERE TraceId = 'ab43116e1d6d4a1a449db547c36ca808' ORDER BY Timestamp
